title: Meet the host of the Pure Beauty Awards 2026: Ateh Jewel
summary: Broadcaster and entrepreneur Ateh Jewel talks beauty innovation, impactful moments and what she is most excited for on the night ahead of her return to host the Pure Beauty Awards 2026, which takes place in London on 15 October
